unresolved_gaps: The OpenAI 2024 figure in e1 was a projection reported in September 2024, not audited results.
Full 2024 financials for other prominent firms (Mistral, Perplexity, xAI, Cohere) were not located, so 'almost every' rests mainly on the two largest players plus a known exception.
The second clause about innovations and 'atrophy of the foundation models' has no testable measure and is not scored.
